title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في اجتماع أمناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Meeting of the Trustees of the International Union of Muslim Scholars
body_ar:
شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في اجتماع مجلس أمناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في دورته الثالثة المنعقدة صباح السبت 3 صفر 1435 هجرى الموافق 7 ديسمبر 2013 وذلك تحت رئاسة فضيلة العلامة الدكتور الشيخ يوسف القرضاوى رئيس الاتحاد ونائبه سماحة المفتي الشيخ أحمد الخليلي وبحضور فضيلة الامين العام الاستاذ الدكتور على القره داغى و الأمناء المساعدون واللجان الاستشارية فضلا عن رؤساء الامانات.

وقد بدأ الاجتماع بتلاوة مباركة من القرآن الكريم افتتح بها الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو.

ثم كلمة للأمين العام استعرض من خلالها جدول الاعمال ومسار الاجتماع قبل ان يتقدم رئيس الاتحاد بالكلمة الافتتاحية للاجتماع التى رحب فى مستهلها بالحضور الكريم واثنى فيها على دولة قطر مشيدا بما تبذله دولة قطر من دعم لكل قضايا الامة الاسلامية وخاصة القضية الاولى قضية فلسطين وقضايا بلدان الربيع العربى وقد ختم كلمته بدعوة العلماء الى استعادة دورهم الشرعى بقيادة الامة وتصحيح مسارها وترشيد صحوتها بوسطية واعتدال بعيدا عن افكار التطرف .

وكانت النقطة الثانية بجدول اعمال الاجتماع عبارة عن تقرير عام عن نشاطات الاتحاد خلال السنة المنصرمة قدمه فضيلة الامين العام فى محاور تتعلق بالتوصيات التى اقرها اجتماع مجلس الامناء السابق ونشاطات وانجازات الاتحاد ومشاريعه المستقبلية .
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part in the meeting of the Board of Trustees of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, in its third session, held on the morning of Saturday 3 Safar 1435 AH, corresponding to 7 December 2013, under the chairmanship of his eminence the learned Dr Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi, president of the Union, and of his deputy, his eminence the Mufti Sheikh Ahmad al-Khalili, and in the presence of his eminence the Secretary-General, Professor Dr Ali al-Qaradaghi, the assistant secretaries and the advisory committees, as well as the heads of the secretariats.

The meeting began with a blessed recitation from the Noble Qur'an, with which Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew opened it.

Then came an address by the Secretary-General, in which he reviewed the agenda and the course of the meeting, before the president of the Union delivered the opening address of the meeting. At its outset he welcomed those honourable persons present, and in it he praised the State of Qatar, commending the support Qatar extends to all the causes of the Islamic Ummah, and above all to the first cause, the cause of Palestine, and to the causes of the countries of the Arab Spring. He closed his address by calling upon the scholars to recover their proper role in leading the Ummah, correcting its course and guiding its awakening with balance and moderation, far from the ideas of extremism.

The second item on the agenda of the meeting was a general report on the Union's activities over the past year, presented by his eminence the Secretary-General under headings relating to the recommendations approved by the previous meeting of the Board of Trustees, and to the Union's activities, achievements and future projects.

flags.arabic: صيغة الخبر الصحفي (قال فضيلة الشيخ... مؤكدا... وأضاف...)
options: render as a site news report, with the Sheikh's words marked as the site's paraphrase
render as a text by the Sheikh
flags.note: NOT A TEXT BY THE SHEIKH. This record is the site's own news write-up. Outside the passages placed in quotation marks, every formulation is the site editor's indirect report of what the Sheikh said, not his own wording, and the English preserves the reporting verbs (the Sheikh said that..., he affirmed that...) so that a reader can see this. It must not be displayed as a fatwa or as a text of his. The underlying address or lecture is not in this record.

flags.arabic: وقد ختم كلمته بدعوة العلماء الى استعادة دورهم الشرعى … بوسطية واعتدال بعيدا عن افكار التطرف
flags.context: the closing of the opening address at the meeting
options: attribute this to the president of the Union (al-Qaradawi), as the Arabic does
flags.note: ATTRIBUTION. Everything from 'Then came an address by the Secretary-General' to the end of that paragraph is the words and positions of OTHER people at the meeting, chiefly the Union's president, not of Sheikh al-Dedew. His own participation in this record consists of attending and of opening the session with a Qur'anic recitation; he is reported as saying nothing. A display that presents this page under his name risks reading the Union's praise of Qatar and its political positions as his. Flagged for the site's display logic.

translator_notes: The record is almost entirely free of the Egyptian-style final yāʾ for alif maqṣūrah (هجرى, القرضاوى, الشرعى, التى, فى) and of hamza (الامين, الاعمال, الامة). These are the source's orthography, preserved in body_ar; they do not affect the sense.
الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين is rendered by the body's own English name, the International Union of Muslim Scholars.
الامناء المساعدون is nominative where the syntax calls for accusative; a source slip, not translated as anything else.
